title: TX queue vector generator: compare nested JSON types strictly
description: Round-3 security review found expect_path's scalar type check does not recurse into lists/dicts, so Python equality still treats nested false equal to 0 and true equal to 1. Implement recursive strict-type equality for JSON objects/arrays/scalars and use it for every expected path.
acceptance_criteria: Nested boolean/integer substitutions fail validation with a clear path; canonical vector generation and lint pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
